$comment: Image templates: the Agencidev site's own compositions (the homepage statement and work rail, the 404 page's no-signal static, the about page's bets and process, the contact head, the testimonials, the brand kit's marks and the share image), drawn as the site draws (layouts.mjs says how). The first size is the template's own frame; the others are the same layout re-flowed. Slots hold sample copy (the site's own words), drawn only with --sample ({domain} and {tagline} come from brand.json); the address (url) is always drawn, and every other slot only when it is passed. `required` slots must be passed. Pictures fill the photo slots in order and repeat when there are fewer. The site's client work, team and testimonials are never shipped: pass your own pictures and names.
